commits.comment: 新增 Sampling Mask（Distribution Replay / Mask Replay）特性，用于 RL 训练（如 GRPO）中对齐旧/新策略在 top-k/top-p 截断分布上的 logprob 归一化支撑集。实现链路：ModelConfig 新增 return_sampling_mask（默认 False），VllmConfig._verify_sampling_replay_config 校验 V2 runner/无推测解码/无扩散/无 logits processor/logprobs_mode=processed_logprobs；Sampler 在启用时禁用 FlashInfer，通过 Triton kernel（_pack_sampling_mask_kernel）将有限 logits 支撑集位打包为 SamplingMaskTensors，经 AsyncOutput 异步 D2H 转 SamplingMaskLists，Scheduler 按请求切分 new_sampling_mask 放入 EngineCoreOutput（Rust 协议同步扩展），OutputProcessor 在请求完成时合并为 CompletionOutput.sampling_mask。风险：特性是可选开关且默认关闭，但触及模型运行器/采样/调度/输出多条通用链路；Triton kernel 在新平台的可移植性需验证。

ascend_impact.functionality: ModelConfig 新增 return_sampling_mask 字段（默认 False）；VllmConfig 在启用时强制 Model Runner V2 并限制与 spec decode/diffusion/logits processors 的组合。GPUModelRunner（NPUModelRunnerV2 的基类）构造 Sampler 时传入 return_sampling_mask，Sampler 在该标志下禁用 FlashInfer 并调用 SamplingMaskTensors.from_logits（Triton 位打包 kernel）；Scheduler 将 new_sampling_mask 写入 EngineCoreOutput，OutputProcessor 合并为 CompletionOutput.sampling_mask。vllm-ascend 的 V2 runner 继承 GPUModelRunner，若用户启用该特性，其采样与异步 D2H 链路需支持掩码 kernel 与 sampling_mask_tensors 处理（vllm_ascend 自定义采样路径中该特性默认不会生效但不会崩溃，sampling_masks 保持 None）。默认关闭时对现有 Ascend 推理无任何影响。
ascend_impact.testing: vLLM 更新 tests/v1/core/test_scheduler.py 与 test_async_scheduler.py 为 Mock Scheduler 补充 return_sampling_mask=False；vllm-ascend 现有测试不依赖该字段，无需强制更新。

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: The commit is model-local (ultravox.py/whisper.py) with no shared-interface signature breakage (all new params are keyword-only with defaults, WhisperEncoder gains `enable_pp: bool = True`). However it materially changes runtime behavior on NPU: (1) Ultravox's audio tower is replaced from HF's ModifiedWhisperEncoder (dense extended attention mask) to vLLM-native WhisperEncoder whose attention is `MMEncoderAttention`, i.e. `AscendMMEncoderAttention`/`AscendMMEncoderAttention310` on NPU, now fed the segmented-varlen `cu_seqlens` produced by `_build_chunk_attn_metadata` (each padded row split into valid + padding-tail segments, zero-length tails deduped via `np.unique`). This new metadata format is not yet exercised by Ultravox on NPU and must be validated: confirm `maybe_compute_actual_seq_lengths` (eager branch returns `flat[1:]` verbatim) and the FIA TND kernel handle the pad-tail segments and the 3-segments-for-2-rows shape, and that garbage padding outputs are correctly trimmed by `audio_token_len`. (2) The tower now forces a per-layer D2H `cu_seqlens.cpu()` sync inside `AscendMMEncoderAttention._forward_eager_fia` (`_maybe_compute_cu_seqlens`) across up to 32 tower layers; consider the 310P-style `seq_lens_cpu_cache` pattern to avoid the syncs flagged in AGENTS.md. (3) When `enable_tower_connector_lora` is on, the tower processes the whole audio batch in a single pass (no sub-batching) and relies on the punica 'first x.size(0) rows' LoRA-mapping contract; verify `PunicaWrapperNPU` token_lora_indices/background handling for the tower `ReplicatedLinear`/`RMSNorm` linears and the new `get_num_mm_encoder_tokens`/`get_num_mm_connector_tokens` exact token accounting. (4) The `enable_pp=False` tower path calls `get_offloader().wrap_modules(...)`, which routes through vllm-ascend's `AscendPrefetchOffloader` when weight offloading is enabled. Standalone WhisperForConditionalGeneration needs no changes. No vllm-ascend source edits are strictly forced; the work is verification/testing of Ultravox (with and without tower/connector LoRA) on 910B and 310P plus the D2H-sync optimization.
deep_analysis.risk: No API/interface breakage for vllm-ascend (all signature additions are backward compatible and AscendMMEncoderAttention.forward_oot already accepts cu_seqlens/max_seqlen/sequence_lengths). Main risks: (a) correctness of the new segmented-varlen cu_seqlens path through the Ascend FIA eager kernel if pad-tail segments or the np.unique-deduped segment counts are mishandled on NPU (CUDA-only validation in upstream CI); (b) per-layer device-to-host `cu_seqlens.cpu()` syncs in the 32-layer tower hot path (performance regression, may block async scheduling); (c) tower/connector LoRA is a new feature whose punica single-pass batching and token-count contract are unverified against PunicaWrapperNPU; (d) memory increase when `pad_audio_to_max_context` forces full-context padding and single-pass chunk processing. Overall risk low-to-medium, primarily requiring NPU e2e validation rather than code rewrites.

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
This commit ([Spec Decode] DSpark confidence-scheduled verification #47808) introduces a new opt-in `speculative_config.enable_adaptive_verification` feature (DSpark-only) plus a set of mandatory refactors in shared GPUModelRunner/InputBatch/CudaGraphManager/StructuredOutputsWorker paths that break the vllm-ascend v2 runner and the Qwen3DSpark confidence-head loading even with the feature OFF.

1. Fix hard signature breaks in the v2 runner (mandatory, default path):
   - vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py:299 — update `sort_batch_req_ids(num_tokens_per_req, self.decode_query_len)` to the new 3-arg form `sort_batch_req_ids(num_tokens_per_req, scheduler_output.scheduled_spec_decode_tokens, self.decode_query_len)` (order: drafts before decode_query_len).
   - vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py graph_manager_wrapper.factory (lines ~602-616) and ModelAclGraphManager.__init__ (vllm_ascend/worker/v2/aclgraph_utils.py) — accept the new `varlen_decode` kwarg (upstream passes `varlen_decode=self.adaptive_verification is not None`) and forward it; on NPU it must remain False.
   - vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py dispatch_with_flashcomm_padding (lines ~86-106) — accept/forward the new `max_query_len=None` kwarg, otherwise SP-enabled runs raise TypeError.
   - vllm_ascend/worker/v2/input_batch.py AscendInputBatch.make_dummy — add `max_query_len: int | None = None` (pass through to parent) since upstream now always calls `InputBatch.make_dummy(..., max_query_len=...)` in model_runner._dummy_run and cudagraph_utils.prepare_inputs_to_capture (both patched to AscendInputBatch).
2. Structured output kernel (v2): vllm_ascend/worker/v2/structured_outputs.py _apply_grammar_bitmask_kernel and patch_v2/patch_triton.py — the upstream caller now launches with `input_batch.cu_num_logits`, `MASK_STRIDE=self.mask_stride` and writes `req_idx*mask_stride+position` mappings. Update the NPU kernel to the new signature (add cu_num_logits_ptr and MASK_STRIDE constexpr, resolve logits_idx on device, mask inactive positions) or masking will corrupt output / OOB.
3. Qwen3DSpark confidence-head loading: upstream Qwen3DSparkForCausalLM.load_weights now executes `if self.model.confidence_head is None or not includes_confidence_head: self.model.confidence_head = None; skip_substrs.append("confidence_head")`. vllm-ascend's AscendQwen3DSparkForCausalLM.load_weights (vllm_ascend/models/qwen3_dspark.py) strips confidence weights before calling super().load_weights, so the base will null the head and the subsequent AutoWeightsLoader(self.model.confidence_head) crashes. Pass confidence weights through the base (or post-super reload and re-install the head).
4. Explicitly reject adaptive verification on NPU: the feature depends on torch.cuda.Event/Stream (AdaptiveVerificationManager/StepTimingCollector), varlen-decode cudagraphs, AttentionCGSupport.ALWAYS builders and the upstream DSparkSpeculator calling `model.compute_confidence(...)` — none of which exist on NPU. Add a guard in NPUPlatform.check_and_update_config (or patch SpeculativeConfig._verify_args) raising when `enable_adaptive_verification=True`, mirroring the LoRA/PP/eager guards upstream added in vllm/config/vllm.py. The v1 AscendDSparkProposer/DynamicSpecScheduler confidence mechanism (vllm_ascend/spec_decode/) already covers Ascend's own dynamic-spec path and must not be confused with this upstream feature.
5. Config/load interaction: SpeculativeConfig now also sets `draft_model_config.quantization = target_model_config.quantization` for method dspark; verify DSparkDraftModel (vllm_ascend/models/deepseek_v4_dspark.py) weight loading still works under that quantization propagation.
6. Rejection sampler: RejectionSampler.verify now takes a fast single-chunk path `request_chunks=((0,num_reqs),)` and exposes get_max_chunk_logits; vllm-ascend's patched helpers (patch_rejection_sampler) should be re-validated for the compacted/single-chunk layout, though the compacted path only triggers with adaptive verification.
deep_analysis.risk: high — the v2 model runner (NPUModelRunner) is broken on every execute step (sort_batch_req_ids TypeError), at graph-manager creation (varlen_decode kwarg), during profiling/capture (make_dummy kwarg), under sequence-parallel dispatch (max_query_len kwarg), and for structured-output requests (kernel signature mismatch); the Qwen3DSpark confidence-head checkpoint path crashes at load (model.confidence_head nulled); if a user turns on enable_adaptive_verification on NPU it will crash on torch.cuda APIs and missing model.compute_confidence rather than degrade gracefully, so it must be rejected up front. The v1 runner is mostly unaffected (own RejectionSampler/proposers) except for the Qwen3DSpark model-loading break and the new draft-quantization propagation.
